title: Associate Data Engineer
description:
****Job Description****
**About TaskUs:**
TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.
  
  
The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
  
  
It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.
  
  
**What We Offer:**
At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What can you expect in an Associate Data Engineer role with TaskUs:**
So what does an Associate Data Engineer do? Think of yourself as someone responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines, and data warehouses for use by the analytics infrastructure, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top-notch. So come on, now we need your full concentration because it's time to imagine what it's like being an Associate Data Engineer.
  
  
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: you will assist in making accurate and meaningful data available for consumption of TaskUs Business Intelligence reporting methodology. As you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will lead to one thing: that everything you do is to meet an enterprise's data delivery, business analysis, and reporting needs.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
As an Associate Data Engineer, you will:
  
  

* Configure

+ Configures and sets up solutions based on pre-approved patterns to move data from operational and external environments to the business intelligence environment.
+ Management of data integration & ETL jobs - consolidation, aggregation, filtering, validation, data quality routines, dimension creation, etc.
+ Configure and Deploy automation of jobs based on pre-approved and reusable patterns framework. Executes production-level jobs by considering data dependencies, schedules, validation routines, data stream updates.
+ Design, develop and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.
+ Collaborate with technical users to define data requirements & establish business rules to be applied
+ Collaborate with key business stakeholders to deliver and continually enhance the BI platform to provide relevant and accurate insights through the delivery of new datasets

* Test

+ Validate and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.
+ Performs unit and system integration testing, on development projects.
+ Undertaking peer reviews, assisting with testing, and ensuring documentation is current.

* Monitor

+ Monitor Error Handling and Logging tools and processes. Troubleshoot configuration and data errors.
+ Monitor Performance and raise appropriate flags.
+ Identify opportunities to optimize the ETL environment, and implement monitoring, quality, and validation processes to ensure data accuracy and integrity.

****Qualifications:****

* At least 2 years of experience in Data Engineering.
* Knowledgeable with Python, Apache Kafka, AWS Redshift, AWS Glue, AWS S3, and Pentaho Data Integration.
* Strong knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts with understanding of traditional and MPP database designs, star and snowflake schemas with at least 2 years of data modeling.
* At least 2 years of hands-on development experience using ETL Tools such as Pentaho, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Fivetran or Airflow.
* Knowledge on the architecture, design and implementation of MPP Databases such as Teradata, Snowflake or Redshift.
* 3-year development using Cloud-based analytics solutions preferable AWS or GCP.
* Knowledge of designing and implementing streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, or Segment.
* Knowledgeable in Database Tuning and ETL tuning.
* Experience of using Python in a cloud-based environment is preferred.
* Knowledge on NoSQL DBs is preferred.
* Knowledge, experience and exposure to AI tools is preferred but not required.
* Someone who has the ability to work effectively across internal functional areas in ambiguous situations.
* Someone who is a structured thinker and effective communicator.

****Education / Certifications:****

* Bachelor's/College Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication) or 4-8 years experience in place of a degree.

**Work Location / Work Schedule / Travel:**

* Site Location: Any TaskUs IND Site (Remote)
* Work Setup: Work from Home

****How We Partner To Protect You:****
TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.
  
  
****DEI:****
In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.
  
  
We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL
**https://www.taskus.com/careers/ .**
TaskUs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We celebrate and support diversity; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. TaskUs people first culture thrives on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, our services, and our community.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About us\***
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Quantitative Finance (QF) is part of the Corporate Treasury function, which is a part of the Chief Financial Officer organization. The QF team develops analytical solutions using complex quantitative and financial methodologies to measure value and risk. These analytics are executed on a high-performance, computational environment utilizing over 23,000 cores and executing 115,000 jobs per day. The team provides end-to-end analytics support from quantitative research and development to model implementation and platform execution. The role interacts closely with Treasury partners (BSM, GLM, ECM, etc.), Corporate Investments (CIO), Global Risk Analytics (GRA) and other stakeholders to develop analytical solutions, drive platform modernization, strengthen data governance, and support production operations.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This role requires strong critical thinking skills to address complex challenges facing the company and financial services industry, with an emphasis on attention to detail, collaboration, and effective communication.
  
  
Treasury provides an opportunity to gain broad knowledge about the company and its many businesses. Your day-to-day experience will be varied and challenging and provide hands-on responsibilities and opportunities to expand your expertise across multiple disciplines within Treasury and Quantitative Finance.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Support production analytical and reporting execution by monitoring critical processes, investigating issues, coordinating remediation activities, and ensuring operational stability.
* Design, develop, and enhance analytical reporting and forecasting solutions supporting Treasury and market risk activities.
* Drive platform modernization, software transformation, and legacy application decommissioning efforts.
* Utilize automation, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytics technologies to improve efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.
* Collaborate with business, technology, compliance, risk, and global stakeholders to gather requirements, deliver solutions, and support successful execution and adoption of strategic initiatives.
* Produce and maintain technical and business documentation supporting solution implementation, governance, and operational readiness.
* Improve data transparency, traceability, documentation, and governance across internal and external data ecosystems.
* Manage project scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and governance to ensure successful delivery.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
B. Tech (Computer science) + CFA/FRM
  
  
Certifications If Any - NA
  
  
**Experience Range\***
8+ years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Advanced degree in Quantitative Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field preferred; a bachelor’s degree is acceptable with relevant work experience
* Strong programming skills: Python, R, Java or similar language
* Strong communication skills and ability to effectively engage with various stakeholders
* Ability to work in a highly controlled and audited environment
* Self-starter with the ability to independently identify opportunities, prioritize work, and drive results with minimal supervision.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to interpret complex data and translate into business solutions and intellectual curiosity
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a time sensitive environment
* Strong presentation and data handling/analysis experience

**Desired Skills**

* Experience working with large-scale data platforms, databases, cloud solutions, and data governance frameworks
* Experience in software development using Perl
* Experience in UNIX/LINUX environment and shell scripting
* Experience with modern software engineering practices including version control, Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Experience with or academic exposure to techniques in applied mathematics, computer science, financial theory, derivatives

**Work Timings\***
12:30 PM to 9:30 PM
  
  
**Job Location\***
Mumbai

title: Analyst – Automation & Business Analysis
description:
**Main Purpose**
This role is the embedded business-facing BI engineer & automation partner for all functions including Finance in Mumbai GCC. Role holder is expected to be aware of finance the way the FP&A & Accounting equivalent role does and works the requirements bottleneck that slows delivery. It also owns the operational KPI framework — SLA tracking and the broader business-led portfolio the site is taking over from central digitization — and automates it so the Site Head has real-time, trustworthy visibility without manual reporting. Forward-deployed engineer approach, not a downstream report-builder, sits with the site team, close to the business problem, iterating fast, builds fast against real operational questions, with the central platform / digitization team for complex builds / data engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the BI layer end-to-end for the Mumbai GCC: build, iterate, and maintain dashboards and reporting (Tableau/Sigma) against live business questions, not static specs.
* Close the true bottleneck in the program — requirement definition — by working shoulder-to-shoulder with region and functional teams to scope what's actually needed before it's built.
* Partner with the central digitization team on data engineering, security, and architecture governance for anything beyond the BI layer — escalate complex builds rather than solving them solo.
* Drive quality and adoption of self-serve analytics locally, reducing manual reporting and dependency on the shared services pool for day-to-day reporting asks.
* Feed a consistent view of regional KPIs and data definitions back into the global framework, keeping Africa aligned with other regions/functions without slowing down local delivery.
* Gather and translate business requirements directly, rather than waiting on requests routed through central digitization.
* Own the KPI framework for the region (incl. SLA tracking), define what good performance looks like, and automate measurement in Tableau/Sigma.
* Lead steady‑state automation for finance processes (Accounting, Treasury, Controlling, FP&A) once projects transition from central digitization.
* Build and maintain BI dashboards end‑to‑end, iterating against live business questions rather than static specs.
* Ensure KPI and data definitions stay aligned globally while delivering fast, locally relevant solutions.

**Requirements:**

* 5 to 7 years of experience in BI/analytics engineering, with a track record of dashboards used in real business decisions — not just technical delivery.
* Finance diploma/degree will be a plus.
* Hands-on with Tableau or Sigma, and strong SQL — comfortable modeling data, not just visualizing it.
* Databricks awareness is a strong plus.
* Aware of finance and how FP&A/Accounting stakeholders think about numbers — able to hold a real conversation on what a metric means and why it matters, similar in depth to the FP&A & Accounting-facing role.
* Comfortable working with financial/operational data and translating it into KPIs finance and site leadership actually use.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, embedded within a business team, rather than inside a central delivery queue.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
**Technical Consultant – Fraud & Security Intelligence**
**About The Role**
Help leading financial institutions across Asia Pacific solve complex Fraud and Financial Crime challenges through innovative analytics, AI, and enterprise technology.
  
  
As a Technical Consultant within SAS's Fraud & Security Intelligence practice, you'll work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, lead discovery workshops, design enterprise solutions, and deliver successful transformation programmes across the region.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise with business consulting while building trusted customer relationships and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead customer workshops to understand business, functional, and technical requirements.
* Design, implement, and optimize Fraud, Financial Crime, and Compliance solutions that address customer business and regulatory requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs and implementation approaches.
* Deliver end-to-end solution implementation, from requirements analysis and solution configuration through testing, deployment, and post-production support.
* Lead technical workstreams and collaborate with customer business and technology teams to solve complex implementation challenges.
* Build trusted customer relationships by providing technical leadership and consulting throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop reusable delivery assets, best practices, and innovative approaches that improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the growth of the regional consulting practice.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 4–8 years of consulting, enterprise software implementation, or solution delivery experience. Strong candidates with slightly less experience may also be considered.
* Experience delivering enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions within Banking, Financial Services, FinTech, or Payments organizations.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within regional and global delivery teams.
* Willingness to travel across Asia Pacific as required.

**Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Experience implementing enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions.
* Experience with Financial Crime platforms such as SAS, NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM, FICO, Quantexa, Symphony AI NetReveal, or equivalent enterprise solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, Linux/Unix, ETL, APIs, cloud technologies (including Kubernetes), and enterprise application integration.
* Understanding of Fraud and Financial Crime domains including Payment Fraud, Card Fraud, Digital Banking Fraud, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC), and Financial Crime Investigations.

**Who You Are**
**You are someone who:**

* Enjoys solving complex business and technology challenges.
* Takes ownership and consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.
* Builds trusted relationships through professionalism, credibility, and collaboration.
* Communicates confidently with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Has a growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning and mastering new technologies.
* Thrives in collaborative, multicultural consulting environments.
* Is passionate about helping customers combat fraud and financial crime.
* Aspires to become a Solution Architect, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader.

**Career Growth**
At SAS, you'll work on some of the largest Fraud and Financial Crime transformation programmes across Asia Pacific while collaborating with industry experts and leading financial institutions.
  
  
This role provides an excellent opportunity to build deep expertise across Fraud & Security Intelligence solutions while progressing towards Solution Architect, Project Lead, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader roles within SAS Professional Services.
  
  
You'll be encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, continuously develop your expertise, and contribute to the growth of one of Asia Pacific's leading Fraud & Security Intelligence consulting practices.

title: Index Equity Technologist (Python), BlackRock Global Markets, Associate
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Unit Overview:**
BlackRock Global Markets And Index Investments (BGM) Brings Together BlackRock’s Index Investments, Cash Management, Global Trading, ETF Markets, Securities Lending, And Financing & Financial Resource Management Businesses. Together, We Provide Clients With Superior Market Access And Index Investment Outcomes Through
  
  

* World class talent, operating at the intersection of investment insight, markets expertise, risk management and process design
* Technology at the heart of our processes, with in-business tech teams that create cutting-edge IP, providing an advantage in quality, scale, and risk control
* A focus on transforming markets, driving and advocating for more accessible, resilient, and transparent markets to deliver more choice and lower costs for investors

**About Our Team**
BlackRock’s Index Equity (IE) team handles more than $7.5 trillion in global index equity assets across Global Developed Markets, Emerging Markets, Commodities and REITs. The group offers index equity investors one of the industry's broadest arrays of investment choices. Our clients include corporate pension plans, public pension plans, central banks, sovereign wealth funds and other institutional investors.
  
  
**Job Purpose/Background**
The Index Equity Technology team within Index Equity is seeking to expand in order to improve business efficiency and scalability. This business-side role entails working with Portfolio Managers, other members of the Index Equity team and the BlackRock technology teams, in order to build a best-in-class index investment engine. The person filling this role will facilitate the development and maintenance of portfolio engineering algorithms for index investment processes. The person filling this role will act as a Quantitative Developer, partnering with Portfolio Managers and technologists to design, develop and enhance portfolio engineering algorithms that support index portfolio construction, optimisation, trading and risk management processes.
  
  
A successful candidate will be able to understand the index equity portfolio construction process and will be able to reliably build and deliver working code that serves the immediate need, is robust and extensible enough to evolve and support scale as our business grows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement an innovative platform, primarily in Python, for the development, deployment, maintenance and monitoring of portfolio engineering algorithms
* Maintain the Algo ecosystem with Python engineering principles to keep it aligned with changes.
* Enthusiastic and ready to learn and use cutting end tech like AI
* Apply quantitative analysis, statistical techniques and large-scale data processing to improve portfolio management workflows, investment outcomes and operational efficiency.
* Identify, and implement, opportunities for improvement of operational processes using data analytics
* Understand the BlackRock technology platform and integrate portfolio engineering algorithms into it
* Work with BlackRock technology teams that support IE, to ensure that they understand our requirements and build well-suited tools

**Skills/Qualifications**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in Python programming/Algo engineering/Quantitative Development
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in computer science/engineering/quantitative field with strong computing skills
* Programming skills in Python (preferred) /Java with strong object-oriented skills
* Experience with SDLC including agile development methodologies, writing tests before code, version control and CI/CD tools
* Knowledge of Scientific Python stack, experience in dealing with large data sets and statistical processing
* Experience in applying mathematics and statistical techniques to tackle complex problems
* Experience working in investment management, trading or finance related fields is a plus
* Knowledge of equity risk models is a plus
* Excellent analytical, problem solving skills, attention to detail and an emphasis on precision
* Great teammate with high level of self-motivation and inquisitiveness
* Effective communication skills
* High degree of professional integrity, discretion and judgement

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Director, Travel & Expense Management
description:
We're seeking someone to join our team as a Travel & Expense Program Insights Lead to establish and continuously improve an integrated management information framework across Travel, Ground Transport, and Expense, delivering accurate, actionable insights for governance, operational oversight, vendor performance, compliance, and leadership decision-making.
  
  
In the Corporate Services division, we empower our businesses by creating collaborative workplace solutions and commercial services that enhance the employee and client experience, while optimizing the value of our sourcing and third-party lifecycle to enable the Firm to do-and-win business. This is a Director level position within the Travel & Expense Management team.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Design and maintain a standardized management information framework across Travel, Ground Transport, and Expense, including reporting cadence, data ownership, validation checkpoints, escalation protocols, and consistent KPI definitions.
* Consolidate, validate, reconcile, and analyze data from internal systems, vendor reports, billing files, expense data, and operational trackers, maintaining a reliable single source of truth.
* Develop monthly and quarterly executive dashboards covering volumes, cost, utilization, compliance, service quality, safety, vendor performance, exceptions, ageing items, root causes, and required decisions.
* Deliver actionable program insights across air, hotel, visa and travel support; GT route and fleet performance, billing and operational escalations; and expense ageing, rejected claims, policy exceptions, outliers, and audit observations.
* Identify and implement automation and process-improvement opportunities that strengthen data quality, visualization, analytical depth, reporting reliability, and turnaround time.
* Partner with Travel, Ground Transport, Expense, Finance, Sourcing, Compliance, technology, and vendor teams; support business, vendor, audit, and leadership reviews; and maintain action, follow-up, and closure reporting.

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification or relevant certification is preferred.
* At least seven years of experience in management information, business analytics, reporting governance, or operational and financial controls, ideally within a global financial institution or shared-services environment.
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise MIS frameworks, executive dashboards, KPIs, SLAs, reconciliations, data controls, exception management, and multi-source reporting.
* Advanced Excel and business-intelligence capability, with experience in data visualization, workflow automation, AI-enabled reporting, trend analysis, and root-cause analysis.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with the ability to translate cost, volume, utilization, billing, compliance, safety, and vendor-performance data into clear recommendations.
* Executive-level communication, presentation, stakeholder-influencing, planning, prioritization, and team-leadership skills; relevant exposure to travel, ground transport, expense, vendor billing, audit, or financial governance is preferred.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

title: Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems - Roofsol Energy
description:
**Job Description – Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems**

**Company:**
Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:**
Technology / Digital Solutions

**Experience:**
Approximately 10 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Roofsol Energy**

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, developing and managing solar projects across India. The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential.

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India.

**Role Overview**

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy and Technology Development**

·      Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy’s proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem.

·      Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment.

·      Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures.

·      Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios.

**2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development**

·      Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment.

·      Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable.

·      Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages.

·      Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes.

**3. Cloud Platform and Software Development**

·      Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform.

·      Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations.

·      Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports.

·      Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required.

·      Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards.

**4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics**

·      Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities.

·      Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations.

·      Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps.

·      Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable.

**5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership**

·      Build and maintain Roofsol Energy’s proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP.

·      Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices.

**6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management**

·      Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics.

·      Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners.

**Candidate Profile**

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline.

·      Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains.

·      Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment.

·      Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture.

·      Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous.

**Why Join Roofsol Energy?**

This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company’s technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India.

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.**

title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Enterprise Automation
description:
As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Revenue Platform Automation division, you’ll lead the engineering efforts driving our Sales, Customer Success (CS), and Finance technology stack. You’ll ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across these platforms, with a strong focus on backend and data-driven solutions. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our systems are robust, integrated, and aligned with the company's strategic objectives. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with leadership skills, driving impactful change in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
You will build and lead a team of talented engineers responsible for developing and maintaining automation solutions for our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technologies. You’ll train and mentor team members, identify and resolve impediments, oversee the integrity of software estimations, and ensure that code and tests meet high standards while keeping scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind.
  
  
This is a backend-focused role, leveraging your strong background in Java, Python, workflow automation solutions (Workato), web services (REST/OpenAPI), messaging frameworks (Kafka), data platforms (Snowflake), cloud technologies (AWS/GCP), and containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) to build innovative solutions. You’ll use your strong knowledge of Sales, Customer Success, and Finance business domains and tools to build complete solutions in sales automation (Salesforce, Service Cloud), finance automation (ERP/billing/CPQ/payment), and customer insights (Catalyst/Gainsight). You’ll ensure your team masters their discrete business domains, maintaining ownership, and accountability for their deliverables. You will oversee the development of strong test automation suites, aligning with automated build & CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery.
  
  
Your ability to collaborate with product management, provide leadership across multiple locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You’ll solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose.
  
  
Your responsibilities span across the Sales & Customer Success Platform and Finance Platform teams, each of which are cross-functional teams consisting of product management, product ownership, and engineers who are responsible for our core Revenue Technology stack. The Senior Engineering Manager oversees the engineers/testers on the teams, identifying and overseeing the solutions that meet internal customers’ needs.
  
  
**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and inspire a team of skilled engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability. Provide guidance and support to ensure team growth and success, empowering them with autonomy and ownership
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of automation solutions for our revenue platforms. Ensure the highest quality code with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Your back-end expertise allows you to dive into the codebase when needed, ensuring alignment with best practices
* Ensure that our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance systems, particularly those centered around Salesforce and its ecosystem, are robust, optimized, and seamlessly integrated
* Lead efforts to enhance system performance, drive innovation, and implement scalable solutions that align with the company’s strategic objectives
* Leverage your strong background in Java, Python, data platforms, workflow automation, software architecture, messaging frameworks, and cloud technologies to drive the technical direction of our revenue platforms. Ensure the adoption of best practices in automation, web services, test automation, and cloud-native delivery
* Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams to align engineering efforts with business goals. Translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies to drive impactful change
* Oversee the integrity of software estimations and ensure high standards of performance, reliability, and security in the systems developed by your team. Vigilantly identify and resolve impediments, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope
* Drive innovation within the revenue technology stack. Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, tools, and systems, ensuring our technology remains at the cutting edge
* Play a key role in hiring, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Set a high bar for performance, create opportunities for professional growth, and cultivate an environment where team members feel valued and motivated
* Establish and drive a culture rooted in belonging, psychological safety, candor, connection, cooperation, and fun. Solicit feedback, engage with empathy, and build strong relationships across the organization to foster an environment where innovative ideas can thrive
* Apply Agile, Lean, and principles of fast flow to enhance team efficiency and productivity
* Model and encourage desired behaviors to support the company’s vision and values. Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

**Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering with deep experience in software integration and workflow automation, particularly in Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technology stacks
* 7+ years in an Engineering leadership role with direct management responsibilities of at least 3 people
* 7+ years of experience in hands-on coding and delivering services that are provided “as a service” to other teams as part of a large-scale distributed microservices architecture
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and mentoring engineering teams
* Expert-level skills in Java, Python, and SQL
* Deep understanding of sales automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and related technologies, including ERP tools, payment automation, billing automation, and CPQ
* Experience with containerization technologies, including Kubernetes and Docker, and an understanding of how to build cloud-scale delivery, including scalability, resiliency, and recoverability
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies, Agile practices, and DevOps principles
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and scalability
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Experience in the financial industry or B2B platforms is a plus

**Working Conditions**
The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.
  
  
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: Quantitative Researcher(unpaid)
description:
**Role:**
Quantitative Researcher (Contract)

**Company:**
Meridian Capital

**Location:**
100% Remote (India)

**Format:**
3-Month Live Project

**About Meridian Capital**

Meridian Capital is a proprietary algorithmic trading firm actively operating in the Indian stock market. We execute our strategies through a fully automated, end-to-end systematic trading platform designed to identify and exploit market inefficiencies with zero manual intervention required for trade execution.

**The Role & Challenge**

We are seeking a sharp, highly analytical, and results-driven Quantitative Researcher for a specialized 3-month contract. Your primary objective will be to audit, stress-test, and extensively optimize the mathematical and logical foundation of our current trading algorithm to maximize our market edge.

This engagement is strictly performance-oriented and structured around two core phases:

* **Phase 1 (The 2-Week Sprint):**
  Within the first 14 days of engagement, evaluate our existing quantitative logic and deliver at least one profitable, mathematically robust model that we can immediately deploy into live trading environments.
* **Phase 2 (Ongoing Optimization):**
  For the remainder of the 3-month contract, shift focus toward developing advanced quantitative metrics, refining statistical models, and continuously optimizing the system for peak performance and risk mitigation.

**Target Performance Metrics**

Optimization efforts must be engineered to achieve or exceed the following benchmarks:

* **Sharpe Ratio:**
  > 1.5
* **Sortino Ratio:**
  > 1.8
* **Win Rate:**
  45% or greater
* **Monthly Return:**
  Minimum 5% consistent growth

**Compensation & Profit Sharing**

This role is highly leveraged toward performance, rewarding the specific alpha you generate directly.

* **Fixed Stipend:**
  ₹5,000 per month (paid upon initial verification of a profitable, working algorithm).
* **Performance Share (30%):**
  You will receive 30% of all trading profits generated by the firm. This profit share activates the moment your quantitative logic is deployed in our live algorithm and remains in effect for the entire duration of your engagement with Meridian Capital.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Strong academic foundation in Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, or a heavily quantitative engineering discipline.
* Proven, hands-on experience in statistical modeling, backtesting frameworks, and algorithmic trading logic.
* Deep, intuitive understanding of risk-adjusted return metrics (e.g., Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, Maximum Drawdown).
* Ability to rapidly prototype, stress-test, and deploy mathematical logic tailored for financial markets under tight deadlines.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian stock market dynamics, market micro-structure, and historical market data handling.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Python, R, or C++ for extensive quantitative analysis and data manipulation.
* Prior experience building, auditing, or optimizing end-to-end systematic trading strategies from scratch.
* A pragmatic, objective mindset that prioritizes live-market applicability and robust execution over theoretical perfection.

title: Right Shore, Revenue Planning Analyst
description:
**Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst**
Full Time | Hybrid
  
  
Location: Airoli, Navi Mumbai, India | Pune, Maharashtra, India
  
  
Team: Right Shore Sales Operations
  
  
Reports to: Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader
  
  
Dotted line to: Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy
  
  
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst, you are the dedicated data owner for Teradata’s revenue planning process. You sit within the Right Shore Sales Operations team and work day to day with the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy to run the data engine behind the annual planning cycle and the year-round change process that keeps the plan accurate.
  
  
This is a data management and processing role. You build and manage the planning templates, consolidate and reconcile submissions from across the business units, keep account and assignment data clean, and take real ownership of the final business build files that hand off into Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. You are the last set of eyes before planning data leaves the process — accuracy is the job.
  
  
The planning calendar moves, priorities shift, and questions arrive without warning. This role suits someone who adapts quickly, can go deep into the detail of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and takes personal pride in a clean file.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the final business build files: Assemble, validate and own the definitive build files for territory, account assignment, headcount and quota that feed Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. Run the pre-handoff checks, resolve exceptions, and sign off on what goes out.
* Build and manage planning templates: Develop, version, distribute and support the planning templates used by business unit teams; track submissions, chase gaps, and consolidate returns into a single reconciled dataset.
* Maintain account data quality: Keep account data accurate and audit-ready — account hierarchy, duplicate records, ARR category changes, ownership and assignment accuracy — through scheduled audits, exception reports and remediation.
* Process territory and assignment changes: Process and validate territory, account and people assignments in Salesforce, including Enterprise Territory Management and hierarchy changes, ensuring every change is traceable and correctly reflected.
* Support the annual revenue planning cycle: Work to the calendar and cadence set by the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — preparing datasets, running the consolidation, and turning around iterations at pace during planning crunch.
* Maintain headcount, coverage and quota datasets: Keep the planning datasets current and reconciled across planning, Salesforce and Finance views, and maintain the change history behind them.
* Process in-year change requests: Handle mid-year changes to territories, account assignments and quotas — validating the request, applying the change, and keeping the audit trail intact.
* Produce planning status and exception reporting: Deliver recurring completeness, status and data-quality reporting so the Manager and business unit teams always know where the cycle stands and what needs attention.
* Go deep when required: Trace a number back to source, unpick a discrepancy across systems, or rebuild a broken file under time pressure — and explain clearly what went wrong and what you changed.
* Document the work: Maintain data definitions, file specifications, run instructions and change logs so the process is repeatable and does not depend on one person’s memory.

**Who You'll Work With**

* Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — your day-to-day business partner and dotted-line manager
* Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader — your direct manager
* UNIT Sales Operations Managers (SOMs) and business unit teams
* Revenue Operations, IT and Salesforce delivery teams
* FP&A and People/HR planning partners

**Minimum Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, sales planning, or a data management role supporting a sales organization.
* Advanced Excel is essential — complex interconnected workbooks, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, nested formulas, template design, data consolidation and validation across large datasets.
* Proficiency in Salesforce. com, including territory and account hierarchy management, assignment processing, data quality management, and running and interrogating reports.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the discipline to check your own work and the instinct to notice when a number looks wrong.
* Demonstrated ownership of a data deliverable end to end — not just producing it, but being accountable for its accuracy downstream.
* Ability to work to a fixed planning calendar and absorb shifting priorities without losing the thread.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, with the confidence to flag a problem early and ask the question that unblocks the work.
* Comfort collaborating across time zones with US and EMEA stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field (finance, statistics, analytics, reporting).

**What You'll Bring**

* Ownership of the Build File: You treat the final build file as yours. You know what depends on it, you check it before anyone else has to, and you do not hand over work you are not confident in.
* Adaptability: Planning priorities change quickly. You re-sequence, absorb new requirements, and keep moving without needing the plan re-explained.
* Depth on Demand: You can drop into the mechanics of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and follow the data until you find the cause.
* Data Quality Instinct: A low tolerance for dirty data, and the habits — reconciliation, validation, exception reporting — that keep it clean rather than fixing it after the fact.
* Process Discipline: You follow the standard, document what you do, and leave the process better than you found it.
* Practical AI fluency: Comfort using a leading AI assistant (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini also relevant) to speed up data preparation, reconciliation, documentation and repetitive processing work — with the judgement to verify the output.
* Power BI experience or certification would be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with sales planning or incentive compensation platforms (Anaplan, Lative, Xactly, Varicent or equivalent) would be an added advantage.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

* Strong SQL skills for data transformation and validation.
* Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms.
* Familiarity with AWS cloud services.
* Experience using Git and DevOps-style workflows.
* Experience implementing data quality monitoring and alerting.
* Experience designing and maintaining production data pipelines.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to design and deliver solutions independently.
* Experience maintaining data platforms critical to business operations.

Data Engineering Manager

**Location:**
Vashi, Navi Mumbai (4 days working from office)

**Work Timings:**
Work from office (12:00pm to 5:00pm) and then support remotely (7:30pm to 10:30pm)

**Job Description**

As a Data Engineering Manager within the Enterprise Data Platform team at PitchBook, you will lead a team of skilled data engineers responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines, managing large-scale data models, and ensuring the quality, availability, and performance of enterprise data assets. This leadership role combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and people management to enable PitchBook’s data-driven decision-making and analytics capabilities.

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across Technology & Engineering, Product, Sales, Marketing, Research, Finance, and Administration to deliver robust, scalable data solutions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a strong background in modern data platforms, cloud architecture, and team development—someone passionate about empowering teams and improving data capabilities across the organization. A core part of this role is shaping an analytics environment that is built for AI agents as much as for people. Our analysts, executives and AI agents should all query the same governed, documented, well-described data and get the same answers. You will lead the team to make that real, with semantic layers, governed metrics, rich metadata, agent-safe access, and evaluation of agent output, and in using agents to build faster and with higher quality.

This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership role: you will guide architectural decisions, mentor engineers, collaborate with cross-functional leaders, and contribute to building next-generation data and AI capabilities at PitchBook. You will exhibit a growth mindset, be willing to solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, and help create a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. If you love leading a team of passionate data engineers, building data-centric solutions, strive for excellence every day, are adaptable and focused, and believe work should be fun, come join us!

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, retain top talent and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Define and drive the data engineering roadmap aligned with enterprise data strategy and business objectives
* Collaborate with senior technology and business leaders to define data platform priorities, architecture, and long-term vision
* Promote a culture of innovation, operational rigor, and customer empathy within the data organization
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of high-quality data pipelines and ELT/ETL workflows across enterprise systems and PitchBook’s platform
* Ensure scalable, secure, and reliable data architectures using modern cloud technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Airflow, Kafka, Docker)
* Lead AI learning initiatives and integrate AI/ML-driven solutions into data products to enhance automation, predictive insights, and decision intelligence
* Champion data quality, governance, lineage, and compliance standards across the enterprise data ecosystem
* Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to optimize data storage, compute performance, and cost efficiency
* Support career development through mentoring, skill-building, and performance feedback

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation, transformation, and automation
* Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), and distributed messaging systems (e.g., Kafka)
* Strong knowledge of data governance, quality, and compliance frameworks
* Experience working with enterprise data sources (CRM, ERP, Marketing Automation, Financial Systems, etc.) is preferred

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex data concepts into business value

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

title: AI / ML Modelling Engineer
description:
**About Business Line/Function**
The AML IT function sits within the BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) CEFS‑technology ecosystem and provides end‑to‑end technology platform that enables the bank’s anti‑money‑laundering (AML) program. Its core purpose is to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into robust, scalable, and secure IT solutions that detect, investigate, and report suspicious activity across the Group’s global operations.
  
  
The AML IT business line is the technology backbone that transforms raw transaction data into actionable AML intelligence, ensuring that BNP Paribas CIB meets its regulatory obligations while maintaining operational resilience and innovation.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The role centers on creating next‑generation AML capabilities and will be instrumental in protecting the BNPP Group from fraud, money‑laundering, and other financial crimes by using advanced technologies and innovative solutions.
  
  
As an AI-ML Engineer, you will design, train and deploy machine learning models that detect money laundering and financial crime. This position is vital for shaping the core detection capability of the platform. This also involves execution of various AML initiatives, thereby strengthening the organization’s overall risk management.
  
  
While direct AML experience is not mandatory, a strong foundation in machine learning, sound engineering practices, and a willingness to learn the financial-crime domain are essential. Familiarity with regulated environments, model governance, or fraud and anomaly detection is an advantage, but we are primarily looking for engineers who can build robust, well-calibrated, production-grade models and reason carefully about their real-world impact. The role will operate within a globally distributed environment.
  
  
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Model Development & Evaluation – Design, train, and assess ML models (NNs, GNNs, gradient‑boosted ensembles, unsupervised anomaly detectors) for money‑laundering detection across transaction, client, and network levels.
* Feature Engineering Pipeline – Build and optimise Spark/Delta Lake pipelines, ensuring feature consistency between training and production.
* Lifecycle Management – Track experiments, version models, and run champion‑challenger workflows with MLflow.
* Low‑Latency Deployment – Deploy and maintain inference services (e.g., BentoML) on the on‑prem Kubernetes platform.
* Calibration & Scoring – Calibrate models and map scores to probabilities to deliver reliable, decision‑ready risk scores.
* Explainability & Governance – Provide model explainability for audits, document design/assumptions/validation, and guarantee full reproducibility and auditability for regulatory compliance.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration – Partner with data engineers, graph/LLM specialists, and compliance analysts to translate detection requirements into production‑ready models.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Python engineering & secure code – Expert in object‑oriented, modular, and reusable Python code; packaging, logging, metrics, and tracing (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); security primitives (OAuth2/JWT) and data‑privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA).
* ML modeling & calibration – Hands‑on with PyTorch (custom architectures, focal loss, training loops, GPU optimization), XGBoost/LightGBM, scikit‑learn/Keras/TensorFlow; deep knowledge of model calibration (Platt scaling, score‑to‑probability, MC‑Dropout), evaluation (PR/AUC‑ROC, F‑beta, lift charts) and handling class imbalance along with the underlying statistical concepts (calibration theory, hypothesis testing).
* Large‑scale data processing – Proficient in Pandas, Dask, Polars (or equivalent) for transactional‑scale datasets; feature engineering, distributed pipelines, and performance‑aware data handling.
* MLOps & lifecycle management – MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry, stage promotion), BentoML (runners, adaptive batching, CPU/GPU pools), GitOps/Argo CD for A/B‑testing and champion‑challenger workflows; CI/CD pipelines with Git/Bitbucket.
* Python microservices & containerization – Designing and deploying APIs with FastAPI, Flask, or Django; async I/O, Celery task queues, Docker packaging, and Kubernetes orchestration for scalable inference services.
* Data storage & query optimization – Strong command of SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL/graph stores (Cassandra, MongoDB, Neo4j, JanusGraph); schema design, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; messaging/streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ); cross‑team and multi‑geography collaboration, rapid technology adoption, mentorship, and end‑to‑end ownership of solutions.
* Strong collaboration and learning mindset, with the ability to work across teams and geographies, adapt to new technologies, mentor others, and take end-to-end ownership.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience with W&B alongside MLflow.
* Evidently AI or similar drift/monitoring platforms
* DVC or LakeFS for dataset versioning
* TorchServe / Triton / KServe (alternative serving paths)
* Exposure to large scale data or streaming platforms such as Spark, Flink, or similar frameworks in high volume processing contexts.

**Education Level**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
Experience Level
  
  
At least 7 years

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai, and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. **About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Company Description**
Aegion is an applied AI lab focused on engineering verifiable intelligence into the core operations of institutions in critical industries. The team brings experience from organizations such as Amazon, Uber, OpenAI, Hotstar, Accel, and BCG. Aegion partners with financial services, healthcare, and commerce institutions to build reliable AI systems where operational and regulatory stakes are high. Its engineers embed within critical functions, leverage the institution’s own data, and design systems so every action is logged, auditable, and explainable. Aegion offers a mission-driven environment for professionals who want to shape how AI is safely deployed in real-world operations.

**Role Description**
The Deployment Strategist is a full-time role based in India (Mumbai/ Bangalore) or UAE (Dubai). Deployment strategists own the problem inside each institution we work with. You sit with executives, find the critical function where AI can change the economics, and design the engagement that proves it. Then you stay with it, alongside our embedded engineers, from first design to full operation, until the result shows in the numbers.

This is not a sales role, and it is not a consulting role. You are accountable for a working system and the result it produces.

**What you will do**

* Meet executives in financial services, healthcare and commerce, and get to the operation behind their question: how work moves, what it costs, where it breaks.
* Size the value in a function in plain numbers, and agree the baseline we will be measured against.
* Scope the first engagement: one critical function, proved in production.
* Work with our engineers on the data, architecture and methods, and translate between the institution’s teams and ours.
* Run the engagement week to week: decisions, risks, stakeholders and results.
* Find the next function and build the case to extend.
* Bring what you learn back into how we build.

**What we are looking for**

* 3–8 years in strategy or operations consulting, private-equity value creation, or an operating role where you owned a process or P&L line at scale.
* You can model the economics of a workflow from scratch and defend it in front of a CFO.
* You are comfortable with data. You can work in SQL or a notebook, and you understand how machine-learning and language models behave well enough to scope them honestly.
* Clear, short writing. Composure with senior people. A habit of doing the work yourself.
* Experience in financial services or healthcare operations is a plus.
* You are willing to spend much of your week with the institutions we serve.

**What you can expect**

* Work on systems in production. Delivering real business value on the P&L.
* A small team with a high bar, working directly with the founders.
* Ownership of results, not hours.
* Competitive salary and equity.

description:
**Synopsis of the role:**
As the Platform Product Manager, you will be the product owner of Equifax India’s core data and decisioningplatforms. Your customers are both internal product teams (Retail, Commercial, Workforce Solutions) and external developer teams at top banks and FinTechs who consume our APIs. You will manage the lifecycle of our high-scale API gateways, tokenization registries, entity resolution (identity matching) algorithms, and orchestration engines. This role demands a deeply technical product leader who can bridge the gap between complex cloud architecture and commercial product usability, ensuring our platforms are scalable, reliable, and compliant.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and execute the roadmap for Equifax India's underlying data platform infrastructure. Modernize and scale the platform to handle multi-tenant cloud deployments, high-throughput batch loads, and sub-second real-time API performance.

* Prioritize platform architectural upgrades, security patching, and scalability.
* Define and track core platform KPIs such as API Uptime (SLAs), Latency (p99 metrics), and Match Rates.
* Partner closely with Enterprise Architects, Cloud Engineers, Infosec, Data Science, and Application Product
* Managers to ensure the underlying platform seamlessly supports new product launches.
* Embed data governance, access controls, data localization frameworks, and compliance policies (such as the DPDP Act and RBI guidelines) directly into the platform architecture by design.
* Maintain a continuous pulse on the global Equifax product portfolio.
* Proactively evaluate global platform capabilities and determine their feasibility for the Indian market.
* Translate global technology features into tangible business solutions for the Indian BFSI ecosystem.
* Partner with local business units to build business cases and pilot frameworks for imported global assets.
* Represent Equifax India in global platform governance councils. Articulate the region's technical requirements, market urgency, and regulatory mandates (such as the DPDP Act and RBI directives) to secure global engineering bandwidth and funding.
* Own the local sprint execution, API strategy and data orchestration frameworks.
* Ensure that local modifications gracefully co-exist with global core platform architecture without creating technical debt.
* Act as the single source of truth for global platform updates within Equifax India.
* Conduct regular enablement sessions for local product managers, sales engineers, and leadership to keep them aligned with upcoming global capabilities.

**What Experience You Need**

* 8+ years of professional experience, with at least 4+ years as a Platform/Technical Product Manager operating within a global cross-functional setup.
* Proven experience working across international time zones and collaborating with distributed engineering and product hubs (specifically US or European counterparts).
* Strong understanding of global cloud-native infrastructures (AWS or GCP), microservices architecture, enterprise API management, data lakehouse designs, and real-time event streaming.
* Demonstrated ability to take a global enterprise product or software capability and successfully modify,localize, and commercialize it for a distinct regional market.
* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a highly quantitative discipline.

**What Could Set You Apart**

* Exceptional stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to influence global engineering leaders and corporate executives to prioritize regional initiatives without having direct reporting authority over them.
* Ability to articulate complex, localized Indian financial market nuances (e.g., the Account Aggregator network, UPI volumes, localized bureau data formatting) into generalized technical concepts that global teams can easily grasp.
* Experience working with Scaled Agile Frameworks (SAFe) or managing complex dependencies across multiple global Jira backlogs and CI/CD deployment release cycles.
